ma.uploadFile(Object object)

Upload local resources to the server. The client initiates an HTTPS POST request, in which content-type is multipart/form-data.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes Developer server address.
filePath String Yes (Specify either files or filePath.) Path of the file resource to be uploaded (local path).
files Array Yes (Specify either files or filePath.) Files to be uploaded. When files is specified, filePath and name do not take effect.
name String Yes Key corresponding to the file. Developers can use this key to obtain the binary content of the file on the server.
header Object No Header of an HTTP request. Referer cannot be set in the header.
formData Object No Additional form data in the HTTP request.
timeout Number 60000 No Timeout duration, in milliseconds.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used regardless of whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

files parameter

Parameter Type Mandatory or Not Description
name String No Item name of a form. The default value is file.
file File No File to be uploaded.

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String uploadFile: ok
data String Data returned by the developer server.
statusCode Number HTTP status code returned by the developer server.

Sample Code

ma.chooseImage({
  success(res) {
    const tempFilePaths = res.tempFilePaths;
    ma.uploadFile({
       url: 'https://example.test.com/upload', // Example address.
      filePath: tempFilePaths[0],
      name: 'file',
      success(res) {
        console.log(res);
        //do something
      }
    });
  }
});

Bug & Tip

  1. tip: Currently, the security domain is not verified. You are advised to use HTTPS.
  2. Files has a higher priority than files.
  3. Either files or filePath must be set.
  4. The file size and file quantity are not limited in the upload. To ensure performance, you are advised not to upload a large number of files with huge data volume.
